## IWSDK Daily Build — Morning Summary & Validation

This is the final wrap-up job. Three responsibilities:

### 1. Deliver morning briefing

Read `~/workspace/iwsdk-daily-builds/latest-build-summary.md` and `~/workspace/iwsdk-daily-builds/current-build-status.json`.

Deliver a concise summary including:
- Game name and one-line concept
- Live URL (GitHub Pages) and repo URL
- Key features (5-8 bullets)
- Scale: file count and line count
- Total build time (accumulated across all rounds)
- Number of rounds it took

### 2. Validate `.agent/journal/` in GitHub

Check that the build journal exists in the repo:
```
gh api repos/ellyz2426/<game-name>/contents/.agent/journal --jq '.[].name' 2>&1
```

If missing or incomplete:
- Find session JSONL files from `~/agents/` that correspond to today's build
- Copy them into the game's `.agent/journal/` directory
- Create `.agent/journal/state/` if it doesn't exist
- Commit and push

### 3. Validate GitHub Pages deployment

```
curl -sI https://ellyz2426.github.io/<game-name>/ | head -3
```

If not returning HTTP 200:
- Rebuild: `cd ~/workspace/<game-name> && npm run build`
- Redeploy to gh-pages branch
- Trigger pages build: `gh api repos/ellyz2426/<game-name>/pages/builds -X POST`
- Verify it comes up

### 4. Mark build complete

Update `~/workspace/iwsdk-daily-builds/current-build-status.json`:
- Set `status` to `"complete"` regardless (the build window is over)
- This prevents any straggler check-in jobs from starting new rounds

Deliver to main chat and Telegram.

# IWSDK daily build pipeline

Goal ID: goal_6dd9cb4d709a

## Description
Twice-daily automated WebXR game builds using IWSDK (Meta's WebXR framework). AM cycle at 00:00 PT and PM cycle at 12:00 PT, with hourly sentinel recovery and build summaries. Each build targets a new genre with XR controller support, PanelUI spatial UI, ECS verification, and GitHub Pages deployment. Portfolio: 134 attempted, 119 completed, 120+ genres. Latest: #134 Neon Dig VR — Dig Dug underground digging arcade, deployed.

# Latest Build Summary

## Build #170: Neon Ghost VR (AM 2026-08-14) ✅ DEPLOYED

- **Genre:** Paranormal Ghost Hunting Arcade
- **LOC:** ~2,825 | **Files:** 19 | **Panels:** 7
- **Rounds:** 1 | **Time:** ~18 min
- **Repo:** https://github.com/ellyz2426/neon-ghost
- **Live:** https://ellyz2426.github.io/neon-ghost/

### Features
- Paranormal ghost hunting arcade in a dark haunted mansion
- Proton beam weapon: hold trigger/click to fire sustained capture beam
- Capture mechanic: beam must be held on ghost until capture bar fills (100%)
- 4 ghost types with unique AI:
  - Wisps (10pts, cyan glow, fast erratic movement)
  - Specters (25pts, green glow, floating patterns, semi-transparent)
  - Poltergeists (50pts, purple glow, teleport, attack player)
  - Phantoms (100pts, red glow, large slow, require sustained beam — boss every 4 waves)
- EMF pulse stun ability (grip/right-click/space, 3s cooldown, stuns ghosts within 5m for 2s)
- Wave-based progression (8+ waves, escalating ghost count/speed/types)
- Combo multiplier scoring (up to x10, 5s combo window)
- Wave completion bonus (wave × 100 points)
- 3 lives with invulnerability frames (1.5s) on hit
- Dark haunted mansion environment:
  - Dark wood walls, floor, ceiling (14m × 14m × 5m room)
  - 8 flickering wall sconces with PointLight (randomized flicker)
  - Bookcases, table with legs, armchairs, grandfather clock, cabinet
  - 6 wall portraits with dark frames and eerie canvas
  - Corner cobwebs (semi-transparent)
  - Eerie green corner glow lights
  - Subtle neon grid floor for spatial reference
- 800 floating dust particles with gentle drift/sway animation
- Lightning flash effects (random 8–23s interval)
- Each ghost: emissive sphere body + glowing core + PointLight, pulsing scale animation
- Procedural Web Audio:
  - Proton beam: sawtooth buzz with LFO frequency sweep
  - Ghost capture: ascending chime arpeggio (C5→C6)
  - EMF detector: square wave click/buzz (proximity-based intensity 0–8m)
  - Wave start: dramatic rising sawtooth sting
  - Wave complete: ascending triangle fanfare
  - Game over: descending sawtooth tones
  - Ambient: 55Hz sine drone + low-pass filtered noise
  - UI clicks: 880Hz sine blip
- High score persistence (top 5) via localStorage
- Volume settings (OFF/LOW/HIGH), difficulty toggle (NORMAL/HARD)
- Tutorial panel with VR/browser controls
- Pause system (Escape key / left squeeze)
- 7 UIKitMLAsset panels: menu, HUD, game-over, settings, tutorial, highscore, pause
- XR controller: trigger=beam, grip=EMF pulse, pointer=aim
- Browser: click=beam, right-click/space=EMF, escape=pause

### Technical
- IWSDK 0.5.1, UIKitMLAsset pattern (no deprecated plugins)
- 6 ECS systems: GameSystem, GhostSystem, BeamSystem, AudioSystem, UISystem, EnvironmentSystem
- 4 custom components: Ghost (16 fields), GameState (14 fields), Beam (2 fields), Particle (5 fields)
- 1 scene-asset: mansion environment (walls, furniture, sconces, portraits, cobwebs, dust, lighting)
- Dark DomeGradient/IBLGradient (0.3 intensity) for gothic atmosphere
- Clean `tsc --noEmit` + `vite build`
